verses.en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.pt: Jacó também seguiu o seu caminho; e encontraram-no os anjos de Deus.
verses.en_web: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.en_bbe: And on his way Jacob came face to face with the angels of God.

verses.en: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.pt: Quando Jacó os viu, disse: Este é o exército de Deus. E chamou àquele lugar Maanaim.
verses.en_web: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.en_bbe: And when he saw them he said, This is the army of God: so he gave that place the name of Mahanaim.

verses.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.pt: Então enviou Jacó mensageiros diante de si a Esaú, seu irmão, à terra de Seir, o território de Edom,
verses.en_web: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
verses.en_bbe: Now Jacob sent servants before him to Esau, his brother, in the land of Seir, the country of Edom;

verses.en: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.pt: tendo-lhes ordenado: Deste modo falareis a meu senhor Esaú: Assim diz Jacó, teu servo: Como peregrino morei com Labão, e com ele fiquei até agora;
verses.en_web: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave them orders to say these words to Esau: Your servant Jacob says, Till now I have been living with Laban:

verses.en: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
verses.pt: e tenho bois e jumentos, rebanhos, servos e servas; e mando comunicar isso a meu senhor, para achar graça aos teus olhos.
verses.en_web: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”
verses.en_bbe: And I have oxen and asses and flocks and men-servants and women-servants: and I have sent to give my lord news of these things so that I may have grace in his eyes.

verses.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.pt: Depois os mensageiros voltaram a Jacó, dizendo: Fomos ter com teu irmão Esaú; e, em verdade, vem ele para encontrar-te, e quatrocentos homens com ele.
verses.en_web: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. Not only that, but he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.”
verses.en_bbe: When the servants came back they said, We have seen your brother Esau and he is coming out to you, and four hundred men with him.

verses.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.pt: Jacó teve muito medo e ficou aflito; dividiu em dois bandos o povo que estava com ele, bem como os rebanhos, os bois e os camelos;
verses.en_web: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob was in great fear and trouble of mind: and he put all the people and the flocks and the herds and the camels into two groups;

verses.en: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.pt: pois dizia: Se Esaú vier a um bando e o ferir, o outro bando escapará.
verses.en_web: and he said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
verses.en_bbe: And said, If Esau, meeting one group, makes an attack on them, the others will get away safely.

verses.en: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.pt: Disse mais Jacó: o Deus de meu pai Abraão, Deus de meu pai Isaque, ó Senhor, que me disseste: Volta para a tua terra, e para a tua parentela, e eu te farei bem!
verses.en_web: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, the God of my father Isaac, the Lord who said to me, Go back to your country and your family and I will be good to you:

verses.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
verses.pt: Não sou digno da menor de todas as tuas beneficências e de toda a fidelidade que tens usado para com teu servo; porque com o meu cajado passei este Jordão, e agora volto em dois bandos.
verses.en_web: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.
verses.en_bbe: I am less than nothing in comparison with all your mercies and your faith to me your servant; for with only my stick in my hand I went across Jordan, and now I have become two armies.

verses.en: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
verses.pt: Livra-me, peço-te, da mão de meu irmão, da mão de Esaú, porque eu o temo; acaso não venha ele matar-me, e a mãe com os filhos.
verses.en_web: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and strike me, and the mothers with the children.
verses.en_bbe: Be my saviour from the hand of Esau, my brother: for my fear is that he will make an attack on me, putting to death mother and child.

verses.en: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.pt: Pois tu mesmo disseste: Certamente te farei bem, e farei a tua descendência como a areia do mar, que pela multidão não se pode contar.
verses.en_web: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”
verses.en_bbe: And you said, Truly, I will be good to you, and make your seed like the sand of the sea which may not be numbered.

verses.en: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.pt: Passou ali aquela noite; e do que tinha tomou um presente para seu irmão Esaú:
verses.en_web: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him, a present for Esau, his brother:
verses.en_bbe: Then he put up his tent there for the night; and from among his goods he took, as an offering for his brother Esau,

verses.en: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.pt: duzentas cabras e vinte bodes, duzentas ovelhas e vinte carneiros,
verses.en_web: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.en_bbe: Two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred females and twenty males from the sheep,

verses.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.pt: trinta camelas de leite com suas crias, quarenta vacas e dez touros, vinte jumentas e dez jumentinhos.
verses.en_web: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
verses.en_bbe: Thirty camels with their young ones, forty cows, ten oxen, twenty asses, and ten young asses.

verses.en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.pt: Então os entregou nas mãos dos seus servos, cada manada em separado; e disse a seus servos: Passai adiante de mim e ponde espaço entre manada e manada.
verses.en_web: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”
verses.en_bbe: These he gave to his servants, every herd by itself, and he said to his servants, Go on before me, and let there be a space between one herd and another.

verses.en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
verses.pt: E ordenou ao primeiro, dizendo: Quando Esaú, meu irmão, te encontrar e te perguntar: De quem és, e para onde vais, e de quem são estes diante de ti?
verses.en_web: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to the first, saying, When my brother Esau comes to you and says, Whose servant are you, and where are you going, and whose are these herds?

verses.en: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
verses.pt: Então responderás: São de teu servo Jacó, presente que envia a meu senhor, a Esaú, e eis que ele vem também atrás dé nos.
verses.en_web: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then say to him, These are your servant Jacob's; they are an offering for my lord, for Esau; and he himself is coming after us.

verses.en: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
verses.pt: Ordenou igualmente ao segundo, e ao terceiro, e a todos os que vinham atrás das manadas, dizendo: Desta maneira falareis a Esaú quando o achardes.
verses.en_web: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave the same orders to the second and the third and to all those who were with the herds, saying, This is what you are to say to Esau when you see him;

verses.en: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.pt: E direis também: Eis que o teu servo Jacó vem atrás de nós. Porque dizia: Aplacá-lo-ei com o presente, que vai adiante de mim, e depois verei a sua face; porventura ele me aceitará.
verses.en_web: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
verses.en_bbe: And you are to say further, Jacob, your servant, is coming after us. For he said to himself, I will take away his wrath by the offering which I have sent on, and then I will come before him: it may be that I will have grace in his eyes.

verses.en: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.pt: Foi, pois, o presente adiante dele; ele, porém, passou aquela noite no arraial.
verses.en_web: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
verses.en_bbe: So the servants with the offerings went on in front, and he himself took his rest that night in the tents with his people.

verses.en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.pt: Naquela mesma noite levantou-se e, tomando suas duas mulheres, suas duas servas e seus onze filhos, passou o vau de Jaboque.
verses.en_web: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.en_bbe: And in the night he got up, and taking with him his two wives and the two servant-women and his eleven children, he went over the river Jabbok.

verses.en: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
verses.pt: Tomou-os, e fê-los passar o ribeiro, e fez passar tudo o que tinha.
verses.en_web: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
verses.en_bbe: He took them and sent them over the stream with all he had.

verses.en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.pt: Jacó, porém, ficou só; e lutava com ele um homem até o romper do dia.
verses.en_web: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob was by himself; and a man was fighting with him till dawn.

verses.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.pt: Quando este viu que não prevalecia contra ele, tocou-lhe a juntura da coxa, e se deslocou a juntura da coxa de Jacó, enquanto lutava com ele.
verses.en_web: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained, as he wrestled.
verses.en_bbe: But when the man saw that he was not able to overcome Jacob, he gave him a blow in the hollow part of his leg, so that his leg was damaged.

verses.en: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.pt: Disse o homem: Deixa-me ir, porque já vem rompendo o dia. Jacó, porém, respondeu: Não te deixarei ir, se me não abençoares.
verses.en_web: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go, unless you bless me.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Let me go now, for the dawn is near. But Jacob said, I will not let you go till you have given me your blessing.

verses.en: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe, pois: Qual é o teu nome? E ele respondeu: Jacó.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.

verses.en: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.pt: Então disse: Não te chamarás mais Jacó, mas Israel; porque tens lutado com Deus e com os homens e tens prevalecido.
verses.en_web: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel: for in your fight with God and with men you have overcome.

verses.en: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe Jacó: Dize-me, peço-te, o teu nome. Respondeu o homem: Por que perguntas pelo meu nome? E ali o abençoou.
verses.en_web: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” He blessed him there.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob said, What is your name? And he said, What is my name to you? Then he gave him a blessing.

verses.en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.pt: Pelo que Jacó chamou ao lugar Peniel, dizendo: Porque tenho visto Deus face a face, e a minha vida foi preservada.
verses.en_web: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob gave that place the name of Peniel, saying, I have seen God face to face, and still I am living.

verses.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.pt: E nascia o sol, quando ele passou de Peniel; e coxeava de uma perna.
verses.en_web: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
verses.en_bbe: And while he was going past Peniel, the sun came up. And he went with unequal steps because of his damaged leg.

verses.en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.pt: Por isso os filhos de Israel não comem até o dia de hoje o nervo do quadril, que está sobre a juntura da coxa, porquanto o homem tocou a juntura da coxa de Jacó no nervo do quadril.
verses.en_web: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason the children of Israel, even today, never take that muscle in the hollow of the leg as food, because the hollow of Jacob's leg was touched.
